vibe_rationale: Community-organised Central Oregon climbing gathering with a faith-based framing and about 300 attendees; a genuine climbing core but thin on programme detail.
fit_notes: Central Oregon climbers of all levels with an outdoor angle, but the faith-based framing and unrecorded age profile limit wellness fit. Seven vendor and tabling organisations and a venue, with no cash sponsors named and no partnership page. Donor-funded and small, and its values may not suit every partnership. A US partner would be needed.
